title: Test Prep Investment Analyzer
description: ROI analysis for test preparation investment across 6 exams (GMAT, GRE, TOEFL, IELTS, LSAT, MCAT). Tab 1: score gap analysis — maps current score vs. target percentile, prep cost by provider (Kaplan, Princeton Review, self-study), and expected admissions tier shift. Tab 2: scholarship lift modeler — estimates scholarship delta from score improvement based on embedded program award data. Deterministic; no network calls.
data_vintage: GMAT 2024 percentiles · GRE 2024 · TOEFL iBT · IELTS · LSAT · MCAT · Kaplan/Princeton Review 2024

target_score.description: Target score; if omitted tool uses 75th percentile as default

target_program_tier.description: Desired school tier for scholarship lift calculation (Tab 2)

score_gap.description: Points needed to reach target score

prep_cost.description: Estimated total prep cost in USD

admissions_tier_shift.description: Estimated school tier improvement from score gain

scholarship_lift.description: Estimated annual scholarship delta from score improvement (Tab 2)

payback_months.description: Months for prep investment to pay back via scholarship lift

mcp_tool_definition.name: analyze_test_prep_roi
mcp_tool_definition.description: Calculate ROI of test prep investment for GMAT/GRE/TOEFL/IELTS/LSAT/MCAT. Maps score gap to admissions tier shift and scholarship lift using 2024 percentile and provider cost data. Returns prep cost, tier shift, scholarship delta, and payback period.
